units.source_text: 昨晚我十分困顿，病人却莫名其妙地把我唤醒，要这要那，

en.t: Last night I was utterly exhausted, but the patient woke me for no clear reason, asking for this and that,

units.source_text: 我气得咒骂起来，过后又平心静气地想：

en.t: I grew so angry that I began to curse, but afterward I calmed myself and thought:

units.source_text: 他真是个不幸的人，自己不由得悲伤地恸哭起来。

en.t: He truly is an unfortunate man, and I could not help breaking down in sorrowful sobs.
